_about: Public-domain Edward Irving (1792-1834), Scottish minister of the National Scotch Church, Regent Square, London, for the Word Hoard: For the Oracles of God (1824), For Missionaries after the Apostolical School (1825), Sermons, Lectures and Occasional Discourses (1828), The Last Days (1828), The Church and State Responsible to Christ (1829) and The Collected Writings (ed. G. Carlyle, 1864-65, five volumes). Washington Irving, on the irving shelf, is another man. from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 59 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
